say:1:1441124001:1.text: The curse on us hasn't been lifted yet. Yet, the dragon has flown away, and the echorites are all gone...
say:1:1441124001:1.source_cn: 矮人的诅咒没解除，龙却飞走了，深岩晶也没了……

say:2:1441124002:1.text: Once the Essail underground learn what the world above ground is truly like, they might want to come up here and see it for themselves.
say:2:1441124002:1.source_cn: 地底的艾塞勒也得知了地上世界的真相，保不准要来地表看看。

say:3:1441124003:1.text: *Sigh* Looks like we've made quite a mess of things.
say:3:1441124003:1.source_cn: 唉，真是搞出了不小的乱子啊。

say:4:1441124004:1.text: The dwarves on the surface will soon have their hands full.
say:4:1441124004:1.source_cn: 地表的矮人们，该忙起来了。
